notes.title: Small patch for a big outcome!
notes.notes:
Hi gummies! 🍭

New tiny little thing to help with previous controllers issues:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/59dd4deac747dffde8d8ce10f8d0079d3ac5ce13.png[/img]

We've updated the input system from XInput to use Windows Gaming Input, so [b]now you don't have to deal with special configurations to use more than 4 Xbox controllers[/b].

Hopefully those of you who used to meet with lots of friends and family to play A Gummy's Life will now only enjoy the fun of the game without worrying about your computers recognizing the controllers first.

Would love to hear your thoughts on this!

Remember, of if you don't know yet, have a look at the new coop adventure game we are developing:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2115760/Oppidum/

notes.title: Tiny little patch for some freshness to the game!
notes.notes:
Although our small team is currently working on developing a new game, our commitment with our previous games is still here and so we bring you a new tiny patch to offer some minor improvements to A Gummy's Life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/00c0d9158ba047185a665931202c700982e505d3.png[/img]
It might not look like much, but pay attention to the following list of
[h2]Fixes and Improvements:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Improved network code to reduce latency, memory management and synchronization time
[*] Your gummy character will turn towards the target when there's no input, so hitting your opponents effectively will be much easier. You asked for it, here you have it!
[*] Improved screen settings behavior with more than one screen
[*] Fixed an overpowered climbable wall in Arigatothewater map
[*] A new profile will be created automatically when you open the game the first time with your Steam user (you can still change it afterwards, but we make sure you start collecting stats from the beginning!)
[/list]
[h2]Soon to come...[/h2]
And that's not all, folks. [b]Our gummies wardrobe of cool hats and glasses will be gone soon[/b]. A full new set of cosmetics will be available before this year ends. 
Have you collected all your favorites so far? If not, go on and engage in online matchmaking battles to get those you're missing. They'll be gone soon!

We hope you guys have fun with friends and family playing A Gummy's Life <3 That's why we developed this game and you make us truly happy when you write to us to say things of the sort.

If you find any issues, remember you can always reach us on our social media ([url=https://twitter.com/EPGames]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/agummyslife/?hl=es]Instagram[/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/gaming/agummyslife]Facebook[/url]) or go to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/585190/discussions/]discussion forums[/url]. You can also join us on [url=discord.gg/agl]Discord[/url] or schedule a match with someone from your region ;)

In case you didn't know, the other game we are currently developing is an online coop adventure game called [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2115760/Oppidum/]Oppidum[/url] and we've also got its own [url=https://discord.gg/b5MhStZk9N]Discord server[/url] opened  

See you soon!
[i]EP Games Team[/i]

notes.title: The spookiest patch is here!
notes.notes:
It's been a while since we brought you the Altar update, and, while we haven't stopped bringing you awesome events and celebrations, we've also been working very hard to be able to bring you a brand new patch with some special spooky features, just in time to celebrate the creepiest time of the year! Hope you like them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/14247fd095e4c4d81fdf9d5035f22990410f167f.png[/img]

[h2]Some issues we fixed![/h2]
[list]
[*] Randomized gummies used to lose their cosmetics before the game, now they will stay glued on unless your gummy gets hit too hard.
[*] Gummies' feet used to bug on BeeCareful tiles, stopping the floor from falling, but all gummies are now doomed to fall.
[*] Scores for King of the Hill mode when playing online with 3 or more players showed the wrong number, for this patch we've learned to count.
[*] After dying online in Grousky, controllers would keep vibrating even after the player's death, we've gone a more eco-friendly route and we've decided to make it stop, to save energy.
[/list]
[h2]New additions to the game![/h2]
[list]
[*] Bored of dying the first in every match and just watching? Don't worry! Enable the new option "Afterlife" in your match customization (local or private) and improve your abilities while your friends keep fighting for victory! After you die in a match, your gummy will still appear as a playable character in the map in the form of a ghost! Spook everyone with your abilities!
[*] On another note, for those looking for a bigger challenge, how about using a ball or a barrel to get a point? Join a match in King of The Hill mode and throw one of the items into a marshmallow for a point, now with style! 
[*] Also, gummies' juices splattered onto cars will start falling slowly, instead of disappearing, little by little, for some dramatic added effects!
[*] And, finally, a fun surprise: when an AI wins a match, if any cosmetics are left around the battlefield, it will try to pick them up and equip them!
[/list]
We hope you guys have been enjoying the game lately and keep doing so with these new cool features and fixes! If you find any issues, remember you can always reach us on our social media ([url=https://twitter.com/EPGames] Twitter [/url], [url=https://www.instagram.com/agummyslife/?hl=es] Instagram [/url] or [url=https://www.facebook.com/gaming/agummyslife] Facebook [/url]) or go to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/585190/discussions/?snr=1_2108_9__2107] discussion forums [/url]. You can also join us on [url=discord.gg/agl] Discord [/url] to talk about the game or schedule a match with someone from your region ;)

Also remember that your reviews are very important to us and help us a lot! ❤  See you playing!

[i] EP Games Team [/i]

notes.title: A Gummy's Life - 1.0.3c Patch - Important online fixes!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/23f4ba477e03819327a6b2e4887198a6f8e78f4d.png[/img]
[h2]Today we bring you a new patch with important fixes to improve your online experience![/h2]

[b][h3]Fixes:[/h3][/b][list]
[*][b]AIs used to take control over the player's gummy in rare cases of a bit of lag detected[/b]; we have a system to ensure other players can still play if one loses connection, but hey, a bit of lag should not make you lose your character!

[*][b]Gummies would get stuck in the online hub if they got out & in of a game very quickly[/b]; we explained to them how agile humans are and they'll handle it better from now on.

[*][b]Fixed an issue with the internal clock synchronization in online mode[/b] that caused, on some ocassions, that other players were not seen moving.

[*][b]Sudden death after a draw at the end of an online game was not working[/b], but there can only be one champion!

[*][b]Remaping the keyboard controls was not working properly[/b].[/list]
[h3]We hope you guys like it.
Enjoy and don't forget to leave your thoughts on the discussion forums![/h3]

[h3]Also remember that you can join our community on

[url=https://discord.gg/agl][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/f7db2eb536f21d97abe4226432eb6f78df1aad65.png[/img][/url][/h3]

notes.title: A Gummy's Life 1.0.2 - Balance and Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/5e02cb255fdf5ad7ab8b49edf48e1de1346983a0.png[/img]
[h1]Hello! today we are updating with some balance and improvements![/h1]

[h2]Balance[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Improved the defense of the Gummy Egg.
	[*]When two or more players tie at the end of a game, the last map is played again with sudden death.
	[*]When two or more players tie and should receive a point, every tied player get the point and not only the one that died the last. 
    [*]Now in Ball or Juice when the timer reaches 0 the gummies won't die. Instead, points will be rewarded but the gummies can keep moving and scoring (Score won't change).
    [*]Scoring a Goal in Ball or Juice now heals and gives strenght to the scorer.
	[*]Zombarn tractor now changes directions (forward-backwards) when colliding with a wall.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/caace1ea11a13bba9d833ca43b85633e24dc7bb8.png[/img]
[h2]Improvements and fixes[/h2]
[list]
	[*]Added a Clear button in the options menu that restore or clear to default all the settings/profiles.
    [*]Improved performance and memory management.
	[*]Now the AI is organized differently depending on the teams selected by the humans on Team Mode (equal size team, outnumber humans, humans outnumber).
    [*]Online Matches list now automatically refreshes when a new match is created.
    [*]Improved online synchronization of the tackle and plank features.
	[*]Improved online synchronization of the Ball or Juice ball.
	[*]Improved online synchronization of the gummy collisions.
	[*]Fixed the Get up animation sometimes not displaying correctly in the remote players.
	[*]Fixed the Robot Wars ground sometimes appearing twice in the online game-mode.
	[*]Fixed some synchronization errors in the conveyer belts of Robox.
	[*]Fixed the AI stopping if it KO'ed the player in BeeCareful.
[/list]

We hope you guys like it.
Enjoy and don't forget to let your thoughts on the discussion forums!


Also remember that you can always join our [url=https://discord.gg/rmh4rPP][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27765963/e0996bd17bc0ffee815fea6aeb11e2cba50dcdd6.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: A Gummy's Life - 1.0 Release
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello! It's time, A Gummy's Life comes out of Early Access today. [/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27765963/70fe395991a9b733dfe7080f2b748fb60c3ae463.png[/img]

It has come to a point where we are pretty happy with the feeling, gameplay, content and bug-free state of the game. As a result of that, we are finally releasing A Gummy's Life.
We want you to spread the word, help us grow, play with your friends in online matches, unlock all the gummies, bring your colleagues over and don't stop laughing among other things!
[list]
    [*][b]Out of Early Access![/b]
	[*]Overhaul of the movement system to the feeling of the game, faster turn rate, better air control, improved jump
	[*]Added more feedback when a gummy is being hit
    [*]Major improvements on the Online network code, smoother and precise
	[*]You can now invite your friends from any region to a private match via Steam
	[*]Improved the human-like behaviour of the AI
	[*]Major performance improvements on low quality settings
	[*]New option in the map selection settings to play each selected map once
	[*]New Online ping meter
	[*]The major feature of clapping with your hands up is now back in the game!
	[*]Improved the behaviour of swapping your monitor resolution and how it affects the game
	[*]Minor fixes in some levels
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27765963/caace1ea11a13bba9d833ca43b85633e24dc7bb8.png[/img]


[h1]A Gummy's Life has also been released last week on the Nintendo Switch® system[/h1]
· Later this week or early next week crossplay between PC Platforms and the Switch will be avalaible, so they have run out of excuses, bring your friends together and have a juicy fight!


[url=https://discordapp.com/invite/E7qRJte][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27765963/0a54297a269eae04beb6fbec6a2ae18625eecdd1.png[/img][/url]
Join the fun, discuss with us in the [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/E7qRJte]official discord[/url]
